A [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Nobody AD" /> [[human]] '''prisoner''' served [[time]] at an [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Imperial Prison Complex]] on the [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Nobody" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|108}}</ref> they informed several [[prisoner]]s that information coming from [[Level 2 (Narkina 5)|Level 2]] of the complex was being translated on their side of the room.<ref name="Nobody" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The prisoner first appeared in the [[Andor Season 1|''Andor'' Season 1]] episode "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]],"<ref name="Narkina">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> which released on [[October 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref> They were portrayed by [[Jack Donoghue]] and credited as "Night Shift #2."<ref name="Narkina" />
